results.title: Kenyan marathon champion banned for doping
results.description: In tonight's edition, Kenyan athletics superstar and reigning marathon world champion Peres Jepchirchir is banned for three years for doping. Also, South African judges leave the courtroom behind and tour a repatriation centre before handing down judgment in 33 emergency asylum applications. And Ghana's presidency has a new jet, but critics of the ruling party are not on board.
